name: Dryfta
description_en:
Dryfta combines research-conference administration with attendee operations. Authors submit abstracts, reviewers evaluate them, organizers record decisions and accepted work becomes part of the programme. Registration, payments, event sites and contact records support the same conference.

The useful distinction is between a working research-event core and optional delivery tools such as a native app or virtual sessions. Annual plans permit unlimited events but still meter registrations, submissions and other capacity. The current enterprise page describes a dedicated managed private cloud, whose hosting and custom work require an agreement.
description_zh:
Dryfta 把研究会议管理与参与者运营结合起来：作者投稿、评审评价、主办方记录决定，再把录用内容排入议程，报名、支付、网站和联系人支持同一会议。

需要区分研究会议核心流程与原生应用、线上场次等可选工具。年度方案允许不限活动，但报名、投稿及其他容量仍有限额。现行企业页描述专属托管私有云，托管和定制工作需在协议约定。

core_features.explanation_en: Manage review decisions and place accepted work in the programme.
core_features.explanation_zh: 管理评审决定，把录用内容排入议程。

core_features.explanation_en: Keep contact, ticket, submission and schedule information together.
core_features.explanation_zh: 把联系人、票据、投稿和议程信息关联。

en: Connect abstract acceptance to a conference session and attendee registration.
zh: 把摘要录用与会议场次、参与者报名关联。
use_cases.basis: Editorial task suggestions based on official documentation; no observed deployment.

steps.en: Define roles, review steps and metered records, then validate one accepted submission and registration through to the programme.
steps.zh: 定义角色、评审步骤和计量记录，再核对一条录用稿件与报名进入议程的流程。

items.en: Selection judgments and examples are documentation-based; no live workflow was tested.
items.zh: 选型判断与例子依据文档，未实测真实流程。

pricing.billing_basis: Annual package or pay-as-you-use credits; registrants/submissions/sessions/emails and optional tools.
pricing.source_snapshot_en: Small $1,499/year; Medium $14,999/year; Large quoted. Annual event counts are unlimited but registration, abstract, session and email allowances apply. Pay-as-you-use is offered; app, virtual sessions, SSO/white-label, messaging and promotion may require credits/add-ons.
pricing.source_snapshot_zh: Small 年费 $1,499、Medium $14,999，Large 询价。年度活动数不限，但报名、投稿、场次和邮件有限额。另有随用随付；应用、线上场次、SSO/白标、消息及推广可能需额度或附加项。

sources.title: Dryfta : #1 Event Management Software for Universities
sources.research_notes_en: Research-event platform links submissions, reviews, programme and registrations; homepage mentions own-server hosting while Enterprise describes managed private cloud.

sources.title: Enterprise Event Management Software | Dryfta
sources.research_notes_en: Dedicated private-cloud hosting, custom integrations and support require agreement, not presumed certification.

sources.title: Powerful, Affordable Event Management Software | Dryfta
sources.research_notes_en: Small/Medium annual capacities; registrants include admin-added contacts and multiple roles; app, virtual sessions, SSO and marketing extras separate.

official_check.scope: Public official documents read; no purchase, account setup, independent review, hands-on test, identity verification or publication approval.

review_notes: Official documentation describes vendor functionality, not independent evidence of reliability, adoption or outcomes.
Original English synthesis and corresponding Chinese draft; examples and fit judgments are editorial guidance.
Current public pricing is a dated snapshot; purchase conditions remain subject to vendor confirmation.

sections.title_en: Test the author, reviewer and organizer views
sections.title_zh: 分别核对作者、评审与主办方视图
sections.en: An illustrative conference starts with a call for papers, reviewer assignment and acceptance decisions, then adds accepted work and presenters to sessions. Verify a conflicted reviewer, revised abstract and withdrawn presenter before publication. The homepage’s replacement comparisons are vendor marketing, not reviewed alternative relationships. No submission or review was performed for this profile.
sections.zh: 例如学术会议可从征稿、分配评审、录用决定开始，再把录用内容与报告人排进场次。发布前应核对利益冲突、摘要修订和报告人撤回。首页的替代比较是厂商宣传，不是已审核替代关系，本文未实际投稿或评审。

sections.title_en: Unlimited events still have metered records
sections.title_zh: 不限活动仍有记录容量
sections.en: Small lists $1,499/year for 100 abstract submissions, 100 registrants, 25 in-person sessions and 3,000 emails. Medium lists $14,999/year for 1,000 submissions, 1,000 registrants, 150 sessions and 10,000 emails; Large is quoted. The FAQ defines registrants broadly, including contacts added by admins, reviewers, authors and other roles. Ask how duplicates and multi-role people consume capacity; ticket buyers alone are not a safe estimate.
sections.zh: Small 年费 $1,499，含 100 投稿、100 报名记录、25 个线下场次及 3,000 邮件；Medium 年费 $14,999，含 1,000 投稿、1,000 报名记录、150 场次和 10,000 邮件，Large 询价。FAQ 广义定义报名记录，包括管理员加入的联系人、评审、作者等角色。应确认重复和多角色人员如何计量，不能只按买票人数估算。

sections.title_en: Price the app and virtual delivery separately
sections.title_zh: 单独核算应用与线上交付
sections.en: Annual-plan notes say virtual sessions, the native event app, white-label/SSO, text messages and EventBoost may need additional purchases or credits. Some comparison rows still say included underneath an excluded module, so use the explicit module notes and obtain a scoped quote. The FAQ allows an own payment gateway and says Dryfta does not hold funds; processor charges and refunds still need separate confirmation. CSV exports are documented but untested.
sections.zh: 年度说明称线上场次、原生应用、白标/SSO、短信及 EventBoost 可能另购或用额度。部分表格在排除模块下仍列“包含”，应以明确模块说明并结合范围报价确认。FAQ 允许自有支付网关，并称 Dryfta 不持有资金，但支付商费用与退款仍需另核。CSV 导出有文档，未实测。

sections.en: The homepage mentions hosted service or organization servers, while the enterprise page focuses on a dedicated managed private cloud. These descriptions do not establish that a self-hosted package is included in an annual subscription. Agree infrastructure, migration, sign-in, access, backups and support before setup. Dryfta merits investigation for research events requiring linked reviews and registration; a simple meetup may not need this workflow. No source-code license or security certification was independently verified.
sections.zh: 首页提到托管服务或机构服务器，企业页则聚焦专属托管私有云，不能证明年度订阅已包含自托管服务包。配置前需约定基础设施、迁移、登录、访问、备份和支持。需要连接评审与报名的研究会议可考虑 Dryfta，简单聚会未必需要。本次未独立核实源码许可或安全认证。

research_gaps: No abstract review, ticket/payment, export, app or private-cloud deployment was tested.
Exact registrant deduplication, conflicting inclusion labels, add-on prices, deployment rights, license and contractual recovery/retention require confirmation.

content_method.author: Codex (AI assistant)
content_method.method: Public primary-source research, original English editorial synthesis and Chinese translation. Hypothetical examples are not executed tests.
